name: Conductor's Instrument

source.title: Pathfinder Beginner Box: Secrets of the Unlit Star

text:
This item can be found in the form of any variety of handheld musical instruments. The instrument grants you a +1 item bonus to Performance checks while playing music with it. Once per day, you can use the following activity.

---
Activate—Command Performance 2 (manipulate)

Effect You play a special tune on the instrument, causing it to cast a DC 17 Command bard spell.
